name: Jonathan (son of Annas)
title: High Priest, son of Annas
summary: Jonathan was one of the sons of Annas and served as high priest after his brother-in-law Caiaphas. He belonged to the influential priestly family in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: From the high priestly lineage
keyEvents.description: Jonathan belonged to the family of Annas, the high priestly family mentioned in Acts.
